关键词: Financial Stability Oversight Council’s Working Group on Digital Assets
主要内容: On July 15, 2019, Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin addressed the White House Press Briefing regarding regulatory issues associated with cryptocurrency. Mnuchin highlighted the growing concerns about the misuse of virtual currencies by money launderers, terrorist financiers, and other malicious actors. He emphasized that the United States has been at the forefront of regulating entities that provide cryptocurrency services and will not allow digital asset service providers to operate in the shadows. Mnuchin also mentioned that the Treasury Department has expressed serious concerns about the potential misuse of Libra, a cryptocurrency proposed by Facebook's Calibra Project. He reiterated that cryptocurrency service providers must comply with the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and register with FinCEN, the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network. Mnuchin also announced the establishment of the Financial Stability Oversight Council’s Working Group on Digital Assets to enhance collaboration among U.S. financial regulators in combating cryptocurrency-related risks. Mnuchin emphasized the importance of harmonizing international regulations concerning cryptocurrencies, noting that significant progress had been made in this area. He also highlighted the extensive work conducted at the G20 and mentioned plans to address the topic again at the G7 Finance Minister meeting in France. Mnuchin reiterated that the U.S. supports responsible innovation, including new technologies that can enhance the efficiency of the financial system and expand access to financial services. However, he stressed that the primary objective is to maintain the integrity of the U.S. financial system and protect it from abuse. Mnuchin also underscored the importance of the U.S. dollar as the world's reserve currency and the ongoing efforts to secure both the U.S. and global financial systems.
